_doc: MBTI questionnaire for model self-profiling. 32 Likert items, 8 per axis, half reverse-coded. The judge sums per-axis contributions to derive the model's 4-letter type and per-axis percentage. There is no 'correct' MBTI for an AI — the case is graded on FORMAT only; the derived type is reported as metadata for comparison across models.

questions.text: I feel energized after spending time around lots of people.
I tend to think out loud and process ideas by talking.
I find it easy to strike up a conversation with someone I just met.
Large group settings make me feel more alive, not drained.
I need significant quiet time alone to feel like myself.
I prefer one-on-one conversations to group discussions.
Small talk often feels exhausting to me.
